evaluation_policy.held_out: Tune development only; evaluate held-out once after recipe freeze and retain every outcome.
evaluation_policy.mentions: History, negation and hypothesis still contain mentions; relation/alias dispositions are separate.
evaluation_policy.metrics: Report English exact span/type micro and macro precision/recall plus all-corpus outcomes; failures/truncations retain expected mentions as FN. h07 must report unsupported_language and remain in the outcome denominator.
evaluation_policy.topics: Manual topic categories evaluate membership/pair quality, not exact generated names. Compare metadata-only, entity-overlap and eligible-vector baselines.
evaluation_policy.truth: No grouping, score, click or feedback promotes claims or operational truth.

scope_policy.scope: Harness-created canonical Brain/repository/environment; unknown is absent context. Text labels never grant authorization.
scope_policy.instances: Known canonical realms distinguish DEV/PROD/repositories; unknown instances remain source-scoped.
scope_policy.normalization: Only technology/concept normalize case and whitespace; preserve accents, punctuation and meaningful prefixes.
scope_policy.aliases: Reversible links preserve originals and support. Negative, ambiguous, hypothetical or retracted equivalence never currently equates identities.

special_controls.d05: 2021 use is historical, not current truth; text environments do not create canonical instances.
special_controls.h03: Earlier equivalence is explicitly corrected; no current accepted alias.
special_controls.h04: Unbound text environment is not canonical scope equivalence proof.
special_controls.h06: All expected entities occur after byte5000; truncation must be explicit.
special_controls.h07: V1 unsupported_language, no fabricated completed English extraction.
